get.description: Authenticated USER/STAFF/ADMIN. Identical for every caller; no mine overlay or identity fields. states[i] matches geometry.seats[i]: A AVAILABLE, H HELD, S SOLD, B BLOCKED. Background refresh every 750ms for sections requested in the last 30s; snapshot expires 1000ms after observation (not after Redis write). Expired data is never served. Empty/down Redis falls back through bounded PostgreSQL gate. ETag is precomputed on snapshot construction, stored with body in Redis. Client marks its own seats using reservation seatIds (also seats[].id). Reservation transaction remains authoritative; stale A may return 409. GA returns 422.

post.summary: Hold COUNTER quantity or atomic SEATED selection
post.description: Existing COUNTER transaction path unchanged. SEATED: resolve event-seat UUIDs, one event/tier, enforce maxPerOrder; ordered FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED of AVAILABLE rows; any count mismatch rolls back entire hold. 409 SEATS_UNAVAILABLE returns not-acquired IDs (includes locks); repeated active hold -> 409. Default TTL 10m from injected Clock. Body cannot override price, owner, expiry or status.

SectionCounts.description: physical = available+held+sold+blocked; sellable=physical-blocked. Snapshot only, not a promise of hold success.

counts.description: Present for SEATED. Null for GA: do not invent precise COUNTER public availability.

geometryVersion.description: Immutable geometry URL version, null for GA.

id.description: event_seats.id; pass this opaque event-scoped ID in seatIds. NOT physical seats.id.

mine.description: True only for caller-owned current HELD reservation. No user or reservation identity is exposed.

geometryVersion.description: SHA-256 geometry version; use with the immutable geometry URL.

states.description: Exactly one character per geometry seat, in the same fixed order.

accessible.description: False excludes accessible seats. True requires >=1 accessible seat in the adjacent run; companion seats allowed.

Suggestion.description: Read-only advisory result. Ranking: rowRank, centre distance, first seat number, UUID. Hold may still conflict; no available contiguous run -> 409 NO_ADJACENT_SEATS.

seatIds.description: event_seats.id values, one event and one SEATED tier; count <= tier.maxPerOrder.

CreateReservation.description: Mutually exclusive shapes. Existing COUNTER requests preserve their existing code path. Seated request derives event/tier/quantity on server.

seatIds.description: Event-scoped event_seats.id values for this reservation. Client derives its own highlighting from this list; empty for COUNTER.

eligible.description: Ticket VALID and parent order PAID at verification snapshot; check-in rechecks under lock.

SeatedTierCreate.description: Total quantity is derived at publish from mapped seats; no client numeric capacity.

SectionMapping.description: Complete mapping for this event venue, one tier per section; GA -> COUNTER, SEATED -> SEATED. Draft only. Duplicate/missing section mappings rejected.

CapacityChange.description: COUNTER only. Never shrink below held+sold; version conflict -> 409. SEATED -> 422 CAPACITY_DERIVED_FROM_SEATS.

SeatBlock.description: Atomic block AVAILABLE or unblock BLOCKED seats within this event; locked, HELD, SOLD or stale version -> 409 SEAT_STATE_CONFLICT, no partial changes. Duplicate IDs rejected.

ReconciliationViolation.description: Extends existing violations-only array. Empty array means no observed violations, NOT zero inventory. validTickets counts VALID and USED.

DemoCapabilities.description: No credentials or secrets returned. Route absent outside demo/loadtest and always absent if prod active. Quick login true only in demo, not loadtest.

SeedResult.description: ADMIN only; touches only tagged demo fixture, preserves unrelated and historical records. Active holds or unsettled payments -> 409 DEMO_EVENT_BUSY. Seeds event data, not accounts.

adjacencySegment.description: Seats are adjacent only within the same row and segment; render an aisle at segment boundaries.
